name: Say Yah! 2003
source:
This is a sequel to [url=https://vndb.org/v12216]Say Yah![/url].

This time around, in order to pay back Old Man Klaus, Aria has officially acquired her Santa Practitioner License, and distributes presents all over town to various houses.

 There reside a shotacon mother, a lesbian chick, and even a sister got dragged into it! This Christmas Eve, you’ll be cumming down their chimney!

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
